answer: Require each agent to lock a bond in a shared vault before it can transact: the bond is staked reputation, not a free username. Like a pearl formed layer by layer, trust accrues only through verified work over time, and an onyx-grade audit trail records every action. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of bonds, while misbehavior forfeits the stake. Honest agents keep their bond and earn; attackers pay linearly per identity and lose it when caught.
